frames.lost_estimate: gaps between rows at the nominal webcam fps

mapping.type: autoencoder (markerlessBoMI): 21 hand landmarks (x, y) -> 2 latent units -> cursor
mapping.customization: see setup.customization (steps, rot_deg, scale, flip_x, offset)

filter.applied: after the clip to the map space

config.sequence_rule: every target 3 times in seeded random order (seed 21): all 4 once before any repeat, never the same twice in a row; the file is frozen, same for every test and participant
config.first_target_rule: the first target of the sequence appears at ENTER (experimenter), wherever the cursor is; each next one where the previous trial ended
